namespace submission

/-- `(b, k)` stands for the natural number `2 * k + (if b then 1 else 0)`. -/
abbrev N := Bool × Nat

def up : N → N
  | (false, k) => (true, k)
  | (true, k) => (false, k + 1)

def down : N → N
  | (true, k) => (false, k)
  | (false, 0) => (false, 0)
  | (false, k + 1) => (true, k)

/-- `x + 1` if `x` and `y` have the same parity, else `x - 1`, truncated at zero.
    This is `op_1659_4315` of the ETP's `ManuallyProved/Equation1659.lean`. -/
def f (x y : N) : N :=
  match x.1, y.1 with
  | false, false => up x
  | true, true => up x
  | false, true => down x
  | true, false => down x

instance mag : Magma N := ⟨fun a b => f b a⟩

theorem lhs : EquationLHS N := by
  intro ⟨a, k⟩ ⟨b, l⟩ ⟨c, m⟩
  cases a <;> cases b <;> cases c <;> cases k <;> rfl

theorem rhs : ¬ EquationRHS N :=
  fun h => absurd (h (false, 0) (true, 0) (false, 0)) (by decide)

end submission

/-! Remainder facts from the definitions, as in `experiments/packed-footprint/PackedTables.lean`. -/

theorem add_sub_cancel' (a : Nat) : ∀ y : Nat, a + y - y = a
  | 0 => rfl
  | y + 1 => by
    show (a + y).succ - y.succ = a
    rw [Nat.succ_sub_succ]
    exact add_sub_cancel' a y

theorem modCore_eq_go (x y : Nat) (hy : 0 < y) :
    Nat.modCore x y = Nat.modCore.go y hy (x + 1) x (Nat.lt_succ_self x) := by
  unfold Nat.modCore
  exact dif_pos hy

theorem mod_succ_of_le (n y : Nat) (h : y ≤ n + 1) : (n + 1) % y = Nat.modCore (n + 1) y := by
  show Nat.mod (n + 1) y = _
  exact if_pos h

theorem mod_succ_of_not_le (n y : Nat) (h : ¬ y ≤ n + 1) : (n + 1) % y = n + 1 := by
  show Nat.mod (n + 1) y = _
  exact if_neg h

theorem step {y q r x f : Nat} (hy : 0 < y) (h : x < f + 1) (e : x = (q + 1) * y + r) :
    y ≤ x ∧ x - y = q * y + r ∧ q * y + r < f := by
  have ex : x = (q * y + r) + y := by
    rw [e, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm y r, ← Nat.add_assoc]
  have h2 : (q * y + r) + y < f + 1 := by
    rw [← ex]
    exact h
  refine ⟨?_, ?_, ?_⟩
  · rw [ex]
    exact Nat.le_add_left y _
  · rw [ex]
    exact add_sub_cancel' _ _
  · exact Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_add_of_pos_right hy) (Nat.le_of_lt_succ h2)

theorem not_le_of_zero {y r x : Nat} (hr : r < y) (e : x = 0 * y + r) : ¬ y ≤ x := by
  rw [e, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_add]
  exact Nat.not_le_of_gt hr

theorem mod_go_spec {y r : Nat} (hy : 0 < y) (hr : r < y) (q : Nat) :
    ∀ (fuel x : Nat) (h : x < fuel), x = q * y + r → Nat.modCore.go y hy fuel x h = r := by
  induction q with
  | zero =>
    intro fuel x h e
    cases fuel with
    | zero => exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
    | succ f =>
      have : Nat.modCore.go y hy (f + 1) x h = x := by
        rw [Nat.modCore.go]
        exact dif_neg (not_le_of_zero hr e)
      rw [this, e, Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_add]
  | succ q ih =>
    intro fuel x h e
    cases fuel with
    | zero => exact absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
    | succ f =>
      have ⟨hle, hsub, hlt⟩ := step hy h e
      have hs : x - y < f := by
        rw [hsub]
        exact hlt
      have : Nat.modCore.go y hy (f + 1) x h = Nat.modCore.go y hy f (x - y) hs := by
        rw [Nat.modCore.go]
        exact dif_pos hle
      rw [this, ih f (x - y) hs hsub]

theorem mod_spec {y r : Nat} (q : Nat) (hr : r < y) : (q * y + r) % y = r := by
  have hy : 0 < y := Nat.lt_of_le_of_lt (Nat.zero_le r) hr
  generalize hx : q * y + r = x
  cases x with
  | zero =>
    have h0 : r ≤ 0 := by
      rw [← hx]
      exact Nat.le_add_left r _
    rw [Nat.zero_mod]
    exact (Nat.le_antisymm h0 (Nat.zero_le r)).symm
  | succ n =>
    cases Nat.lt_or_ge (n + 1) y with
    | inl hlt =>
      rw [mod_succ_of_not_le n y (Nat.not_le_of_gt hlt)]
      cases q with
      | zero =>
        rw [Nat.zero_mul, Nat.zero_add] at hx
        exact hx.symm
      | succ q =>
        exfalso
        have : y ≤ n + 1 := by
          rw [← hx, Nat.succ_mul, Nat.add_assoc, Nat.add_comm y r, ← Nat.add_assoc]
          exact Nat.le_add_left y _
        exact Nat.not_le_of_gt hlt this
    | inr hge =>
      rw [mod_succ_of_le n y hge, modCore_eq_go _ y hy]
      exact mod_go_spec hy hr q _ _ _ hx.symm

theorem dec2 : ∀ n : Nat, (∃ q, n = q * 2) ∨ (∃ q, n = q * 2 + 1)
  | 0 => Or.inl ⟨0, rfl⟩
  | n + 1 =>
    match dec2 n with
    | Or.inl ⟨q, e⟩ => Or.inr ⟨q, by rw [e]⟩
    | Or.inr ⟨q, e⟩ => Or.inl ⟨q + 1, by rw [e, Nat.succ_mul]⟩

theorem par (n : Nat) : (n % 2 = 0 ∧ (n + 1) % 2 = 1) ∨ (n % 2 = 1 ∧ (n + 1) % 2 = 0) := by
  cases dec2 n with
  | inl h =>
    have ⟨q, e⟩ := h
    refine Or.inl ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [e]; exact mod_spec (y := 2) (r := 0) q (by decide)
    · rw [e]; exact mod_spec (y := 2) (r := 1) q (by decide)
  | inr h =>
    have ⟨q, e⟩ := h
    refine Or.inr ⟨?_, ?_⟩
    · rw [e]; exact mod_spec (y := 2) (r := 1) q (by decide)
    · have : q * 2 + 1 + 1 = (q + 1) * 2 + 0 := by rw [Nat.succ_mul]
      rw [e, this]; exact mod_spec (y := 2) (r := 0) (q + 1) (by decide)

theorem par_ne (n : Nat) : (n + 1) % 2 ≠ n % 2 := by
  cases par n with
  | inl h => rw [h.1, h.2]; decide
  | inr h => rw [h.1, h.2]; decide

theorem par_2 (n : Nat) : (n + 1 + 1) % 2 = n % 2 := by
  cases par n with
  | inl h =>
    cases par (n + 1) with
    | inl k => exact absurd (h.2.symm.trans k.1) (by decide)
    | inr k => rw [k.2, h.1]
  | inr h =>
    cases par (n + 1) with
    | inl k => rw [k.2, h.1]
    | inr k => exact absurd (h.2.symm.trans k.1) (by decide)

theorem flip {a b : Nat} (c : Nat) (ha : a % 2 ≠ c % 2) (hb : b % 2 ≠ c % 2) : a % 2 = b % 2 := by
  cases par a with
  | inl h1 =>
    cases par b with
    | inl h2 => rw [h1.1, h2.1]
    | inr h2 =>
      cases par c with
      | inl h3 => exact absurd (h1.1.trans h3.1.symm) ha
      | inr h3 => exact absurd (h2.1.trans h3.1.symm) hb
  | inr h1 =>
    cases par b with
    | inr h2 => rw [h1.1, h2.1]
    | inl h2 =>
      cases par c with
      | inl h3 => exact absurd (h2.1.trans h3.1.symm) hb
      | inr h3 => exact absurd (h1.1.trans h3.1.symm) ha

/-- The ledger's operation for `hard2_0027`, unchanged. -/
def f (x : Nat) (y : Nat) : Nat :=
  match x with
  | 0 =>
    if y % 2 = 0
    then 1 else 0
  | n + 1 =>
    if x % 2 = y % 2
    then n + 2 else n

theorem f_same : ∀ {x y : Nat}, x % 2 = y % 2 → f x y = x + 1
  | 0, _, h => by unfold f; exact if_pos h.symm
  | _ + 1, _, h => by unfold f; exact if_pos h

theorem f_diff : ∀ {x y : Nat}, x % 2 ≠ y % 2 → f x y = x - 1
  | 0, _, h => by unfold f; exact if_neg (fun e => h e.symm)
  | _ + 1, _, h => by unfold f; exact if_neg h

theorem w_par (y z : Nat) : (f (y + 1) z) % 2 = y % 2 := by
  cases Nat.decEq ((y + 1) % 2) (z % 2) with
  | isTrue h => rw [f_same h]; exact par_2 y
  | isFalse h => rw [f_diff h]; rfl

theorem law (x y z : Nat) : x = f (f x (f (f y y) z)) y := by
  rw [f_same (x := y) (y := y) rfl]
  have hw := w_par y z
  generalize f (y + 1) z = w at hw ⊢
  cases Nat.decEq (x % 2) (y % 2) with
  | isTrue h =>
    have e1 : f x w = x + 1 := f_same (h.trans hw.symm)
    have e2 : f (x + 1) y = x + 1 - 1 := f_diff (fun e => par_ne x (e.trans h.symm))
    rw [e1]
    exact e2.symm
  | isFalse h =>
    have e1 : f x w = x - 1 := f_diff (fun e => h (e.trans hw))
    rw [e1]
    cases x with
    | zero => exact (f_diff h).symm
    | succ n =>
      exact (f_same (flip (n + 1) (fun e => par_ne n e.symm) (fun e => h e.symm))).symm

instance mag : Magma Nat := ⟨fun a b => f b a⟩

theorem lhs : EquationLHS Nat := fun x y z => law x y z

theorem rhs : ¬ EquationRHS Nat :=
  fun h => absurd (h 0 1 0) (by decide)

end submission

/-- `(b, k)` stands for the natural number `2 * k + (if b then 1 else 0)`. -/
abbrev N := Bool × Nat

def up : N → N
  | (false, k) => (true, k)
  | (true, k) => (false, k + 1)

def down : N → N
  | (true, k) => (false, k)
  | (false, 0) => (false, 0)
  | (false, k + 1) => (true, k)

/-- `x + 1` if `x` and `y` have the same parity, else `x - 1`, truncated at zero.
    `op_1659_4315` of the ETP's `ManuallyProved/Equation1659.lean`. -/
def f (x y : N) : N :=
  match x.1, y.1 with
  | false, false => up x
  | true, true => up x
  | false, true => down x
  | true, false => down x

instance mag : Magma N := ⟨fun a b => f b a⟩

theorem lhs : EquationLHS N := by
  intro ⟨a0, k0⟩ ⟨a1, k1⟩ ⟨a2, k2⟩
  cases a2 with | false => (cases a1 <;> (cases a0 <;> rfl)) | true => (cases a1 <;> (cases a0 with | false => (cases k0 <;> rfl) | true => rfl))

theorem rhs : ¬ EquationRHS N :=
  fun h => absurd (h (false, 0) (true, 0) (false, 0)) (by decide)

end submission

namespace submission

/-- `(b, k)` stands for the natural number `2 * k + (if b then 1 else 0)`. -/
abbrev N := Bool × Nat

def up : N → N
  | (false, k) => (true, k)
  | (true, k) => (false, k + 1)

def down : N → N
  | (true, k) => (false, k)
  | (false, 0) => (false, 0)
  | (false, k + 1) => (true, k)

/-- `x + 1` if `x` and `y` have the same parity, else `x - 1`, truncated at zero.
    `op_1659_4315` of the ETP's `ManuallyProved/Equation1659.lean`. -/
def f (x y : N) : N :=
  match x.1, y.1 with
  | false, false => up x
  | true, true => up x
  | false, true => down x
  | true, false => down x

instance mag : Magma N := ⟨fun a b => f b a⟩

theorem lhs : EquationLHS N := by
  intro ⟨a0, k0⟩ ⟨a1, k1⟩ ⟨a2, k2⟩
  cases a2 with | false => (cases a1 <;> (cases a0 <;> rfl)) | true => (cases a1 <;> (cases a0 with | false => (cases k0 <;> rfl) | true => rfl))

theorem rhs : ¬ EquationRHS N :=
  fun h => absurd (h (false, 0) (true, 0)) (by decide)

end submission

/-- `(false, n)` is `n`, `(true, n)` is `-n-1`: integers with a structural successor and order. -/
abbrev Z := Bool × Nat

def succ : Z → Z
  | (false, n) => (false, n + 1)
  | (true, 0) => (false, 0)
  | (true, n + 1) => (true, n)

def pred : Z → Z
  | (false, 0) => (true, 0)
  | (false, n + 1) => (false, n)
  | (true, n) => (true, n + 1)

def gtn : Nat → Nat → Bool
  | 0, _ => false
  | _ + 1, 0 => true
  | a + 1, b + 1 => gtn a b

def gt : Z → Z → Bool
  | (false, a), (false, b) => gtn a b
  | (false, _), (true, _) => true
  | (true, _), (false, _) => false
  | (true, a), (true, b) => gtn b a

theorem pred_succ : ∀ x, pred (succ x) = x
  | (false, _) => rfl
  | (true, 0) => rfl
  | (true, _ + 1) => rfl

theorem succ_pred : ∀ x, succ (pred x) = x
  | (false, 0) => rfl
  | (false, _ + 1) => rfl
  | (true, _) => rfl

theorem gtn_up : ∀ a b, gtn a b = true → gtn (a + 1) b = true
  | 0, _, h => nomatch h
  | _ + 1, 0, _ => rfl
  | a + 1, b + 1, h => gtn_up a b h

theorem gtn_upf : ∀ a b, gtn (a + 1) b = false → gtn a b = false
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, 0, h => nomatch h
  | a + 1, b + 1, h => gtn_upf a b h

theorem gtn_dn : ∀ a b, gtn a b = false → gtn a (b + 1) = false
  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | _ + 1, 0, h => nomatch h
  | a + 1, b + 1, h => gtn_dn a b h

theorem gtn_dnt : ∀ a b, gtn a (b + 1) = true → gtn a b = true
  | 0, _, h => nomatch h
  | _ + 1, 0, _ => rfl
  | a + 1, b + 1, h => gtn_dnt a b h

theorem gtn_lt : ∀ a, gtn a (a + 1) = false
  | 0 => rfl
  | a + 1 => gtn_lt a

theorem gtn_gt : ∀ a, gtn (a + 1) a = true
  | 0 => rfl
  | a + 1 => gtn_gt a

theorem gtn_self : ∀ a, gtn a a = false
  | 0 => rfl
  | a + 1 => gtn_self a

theorem gt_succ : ∀ x y, gt x y = true → gt (succ x) y = true
  | (false, a), (false, b), h => gtn_up a b h
  | (false, _), (true, _), _ => rfl
  | (true, 0), (false, _), h => nomatch h
  | (true, _ + 1), (false, _), h => nomatch h
  | (true, 0), (true, _), _ => rfl
  | (true, a + 1), (true, b), h => gtn_dnt b a h

theorem gt_pred : ∀ x y, gt x y = false → gt (pred x) y = false
  | (false, 0), (false, _), _ => rfl
  | (false, 0), (true, _), h => nomatch h
  | (false, a + 1), (false, b), h => gtn_upf a b h
  | (false, _ + 1), (true, _), h => nomatch h
  | (true, _), (false, _), _ => rfl
  | (true, a), (true, b), h => gtn_dn b a h

theorem gt_lt : ∀ x, gt x (succ x) = false
  | (false, a) => gtn_lt a
  | (true, 0) => rfl
  | (true, a + 1) => gtn_lt a

theorem gt_gt : ∀ x, gt x (pred x) = true
  | (false, 0) => rfl
  | (false, a + 1) => gtn_gt a
  | (true, a) => gtn_gt a

/-- `x + 1` if `x > y`, else `x - 1`.  The model of the ETP's `Equation1648_facts`. -/
def f (x y : Z) : Z :=
  match gt x y with
  | true => succ x
  | false => pred x

theorem f_t {x y} (h : gt x y = true) : f x y = succ x := by
  unfold f; rw [h]

theorem f_f {x y} (h : gt x y = false) : f x y = pred x := by
  unfold f; rw [h]

theorem law (x y : Z) : x = f (f x y) (f (f x y) y) := by
  cases h : gt x y with
  | true =>
    rw [f_t h, f_t (gt_succ x y h), f_f (gt_lt (succ x)), pred_succ]
  | false =>
    rw [f_f h, f_f (gt_pred x y h), f_t (gt_gt (pred x)), succ_pred]

instance mag : Magma Z := ⟨fun a b => f b a⟩

theorem lhs : EquationLHS Z := fun x y => law x y

theorem rhs : ¬ EquationRHS Z :=
  fun h => absurd (h (false, 0)) (by decide)

end submission

def g (p q c d : Nat) : Option (Nat × Nat) :=
  if q = d ∧ (p = c ∨ p + 1 = c) then some (0, q + 1)
  else if q + 1 = d ∧ p ≥ c then some (p - c + 1, q)
  else if q = d + 1 ∧ p < c then some (c - p, d)
  else none

/-- The model of the ETP's `Equation3342_facts`. -/
def f : Option (Nat × Nat) → Option (Nat × Nat) → Option (Nat × Nat)
  | none, none => none
  | none, some _ => none
  | some _, none => none
  | some (p, q), some (c, d) => g p q c d

theorem ne1 (q : Nat) : q ≠ q + 1 := Nat.ne_of_lt (Nat.lt_succ_self q)
theorem ne2 (q : Nat) : q + 1 ≠ q := fun h => ne1 q h.symm
theorem ne3 (q : Nat) : q + 1 + 1 ≠ q := fun h => Nat.not_lt_zero 0 (by
  have h2 : q + 1 + 1 ≤ q := Nat.le_of_eq h
  exact absurd (Nat.lt_of_lt_of_le (Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_succ q)) h2) (Nat.lt_irrefl q))

theorem L0 (p q c : Nat) : g p q c q = if p = c ∨ p + 1 = c then some (0, q + 1) else none := by
  unfold g
  cases Nat.decEq p c with
  | isTrue h =>
    rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, Or.inl h⟩, if_pos (Or.inl h)]
  | isFalse h =>
    cases Nat.decEq (p + 1) c with
    | isTrue k =>
      rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, Or.inr k⟩, if_pos (Or.inr k)]
    | isFalse k =>
      have hn : ¬ (p = c ∨ p + 1 = c) := fun e => e.elim h k
      rw [if_neg (fun e => hn e.2), if_neg (fun e => ne2 q e.1), if_neg (fun e => ne1 q e.1), if_neg hn]

theorem L1 (p q c : Nat) : g p q c (q + 1) = if p ≥ c then some (p - c + 1, q) else none := by
  unfold g
  rw [if_neg (fun e => ne1 q e.1)]
  cases Nat.decLe c p with
  | isTrue h =>
    rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, h⟩, if_pos h]
  | isFalse h =>
    rw [if_neg (fun e => h e.2), if_neg (fun e => ne3 q e.1.symm), if_neg h]

theorem L2 (p c d : Nat) : g p (d + 1) c d = if p < c then some (c - p, d) else none := by
  unfold g
  rw [if_neg (fun e => ne2 d e.1), if_neg (fun e => ne3 d e.1)]
  cases Nat.decLt p c with
  | isTrue h =>
    rw [if_pos ⟨rfl, h⟩, if_pos h]
  | isFalse h =>
    rw [if_neg (fun e => h e.2), if_neg h]

theorem L3 (p q c d : Nat) (h0 : q ≠ d) (h1 : q + 1 ≠ d) (h2 : q ≠ d + 1) : g p q c d = none := by
  unfold g
  rw [if_neg (fun e => h0 e.1), if_neg (fun e => h1 e.1), if_neg (fun e => h2 e.1)]

  | 0, _, _ => rfl
  | c + 1, p + 1, h => by
    have ih := sub1 c p (Nat.le_of_succ_le_succ h)
    rw [Nat.succ_sub_succ, Nat.succ_sub_succ]
    exact ih
  | _ + 1, 0, h => absurd h (Nat.not_succ_le_zero _)

theorem sub2 : ∀ p c : Nat, p < c → c - (p + 1) + 1 = c - p
  | _, 0, h => absurd h (Nat.not_lt_zero _)
  | 0, c + 1, _ => rfl
  | p + 1, c + 1, h => by
    have ih := sub2 p c (Nat.lt_of_succ_lt_succ h)
    rw [Nat.succ_sub_succ, Nat.succ_sub_succ]

  | isTrue e =>

    | isTrue h =>

    | isFalse h =>
      cases Nat.decEq (p + 1) c with
      | isTrue k =>

        rw [if_pos (Or.inr rfl), if_pos (Or.inl rfl)]
      | isFalse k =>
        rw [if_neg (fun e => e.elim h k), if_neg (fun e => e.elim (fun u => k u.symm) (fun u => h (Nat.succ.inj u).symm))]
  | isFalse e0 =>
    cases Nat.decEq (q + 1) d with
    | isTrue e =>
      cases e
      rw [L1, L2]

      | isTrue h =>

    show g p q c d = f (some (c, d)) (f (some (p, q)) (g p q p q))
    rw [e1]
    show g p q c d = f (some (c, d)) (g p q 0 (q + 1))
    rw [e2]
    exact key p q c d

/-- Binary numerals with no leading zero, least significant bit first. -/
inductive P
  | one
  | b0 (p : P)
  | b1 (p : P)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- The natural numbers, as `none` or a positive numeral. -/
abbrev E := Option P

def c0 : E → E
  | none => none
  | some p => some (.b0 p)

def c1 : E → E
  | none => some .one
  | some p => some (.b1 p)

def xp : P → P → E
  | .one, .one => none
  | .one, .b0 q => some (.b1 q)
  | .one, .b1 q => some (.b0 q)
  | .b0 p, .one => some (.b1 p)
  | .b1 p, .one => some (.b0 p)
  | .b0 p, .b0 q => c0 (xp p q)
  | .b0 p, .b1 q => c1 (xp p q)
  | .b1 p, .b0 q => c1 (xp p q)
  | .b1 p, .b1 q => c0 (xp p q)

/-- Bitwise exclusive or. -/
def xo : E → E → E
  | none, none => none
  | none, some q => some q
  | some p, none => some p
  | some p, some q => xp p q

def hd : E → Bool
  | none => false
  | some .one => true
  | some (.b0 _) => false
  | some (.b1 _) => true

/-- Halving: `x / 2`. -/
def tl : E → E
  | none => none
  | some .one => none
  | some (.b0 p) => some p
  | some (.b1 p) => some p

def bx : Bool → Bool → Bool
  | false, false => false
  | false, true => true
  | true, false => true
  | true, true => false

  | none, some (.b1 _), h, _ => nomatch h

  | some (.b1 _), none, h, _ => nomatch h

  | some .one, some (.b0 _), h, _ => nomatch h
  | some .one, some (.b1 _), _, h => nomatch h

  | some (.b1 _), some .one, _, h => nomatch h

/-- Terms of the free magma on `Nat`. -/
inductive T
  | leaf (n : Nat)
  | fork (a b : T)
  deriving DecidableEq

open T

/-- One root step of the ETP's `rw504.rule`: `y ⋆ (y ⋆ (x ⋆ (y ⋆ y))) ↦ x`. -/
def rule (a : T) : T → T
  | leaf n => fork a (leaf n)
  | fork y (leaf n) => fork a (fork y (leaf n))
  | fork y (fork x (leaf n)) => fork a (fork y (fork x (leaf n)))
  | fork y (fork x (fork u v)) =>
    if a = y ∧ a = u ∧ a = v then x else fork a (fork y (fork x (fork u v)))

/-- Normal forms: every fork is fixed by the root step. -/
def nf : T → Prop
  | leaf _ => True
  | fork a b => nf a ∧ nf b ∧ rule a b = fork a b

theorem nf_rule (a : T) (ha : nf a) : ∀ b, nf b → nf (rule a b)
  | leaf _, hb => ⟨ha, hb, rfl⟩
  | fork _ (leaf _), hb => ⟨ha, hb, rfl⟩
  | fork _ (fork _ (leaf _)), hb => ⟨ha, hb, rfl⟩
  | fork y (fork x (fork u v)), hb => by
    show nf (if a = y ∧ a = u ∧ a = v then x else fork a (fork y (fork x (fork u v))))
    cases instDecidableAnd (dp := instDecidableEqT a y) (dq := instDecidableAnd (dp := instDecidableEqT a u) (dq := instDecidableEqT a v)) with
    | isTrue c =>
      rw [if_pos c]
      exact hb.2.1.1
    | isFalse c =>
      rw [if_neg c]
      exact ⟨ha, hb, if_neg c⟩

abbrev C := {t : T // nf t}

def f (a b : C) : C := ⟨rule a.1 b.1, nf_rule a.1 a.2 b.1 b.2⟩

def size : T → Nat
  | leaf _ => 1
  | fork a b => size a + size b + 1

theorem size_l (a b : T) : size a < size (fork a b) :=
  Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_add_right _ _)

theorem size_r (a b : T) : size b < size (fork a b) :=
  Nat.lt_succ_of_le (Nat.le_add_left _ _)

theorem ne_l {a b : T} (e : fork a b = a) : False := by
  have h2 := size_l a b
  rw [e] at h2
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ h2

theorem ne_rl {p q r : T} (e : fork p (fork q r) = q) : False := by
  have h1 := size_r p (fork q r)
  have h2 := size_l q r
  rw [e] at h1
  exact Nat.lt_irrefl _ (Nat.lt_trans h1 h2)

theorem r1 : ∀ y : T, rule y y = fork y y
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | fork _ (leaf _) => rfl
  | fork _ (fork _ (leaf _)) => rfl
  | fork _ (fork _ (fork _ _)) => if_neg (fun c => ne_l c.1)

theorem r2 (x : T) : ∀ y : T, rule x (fork y y) = fork x (fork y y)
  | leaf _ => rfl
  | fork _ (leaf _) => rfl
  | fork _ (fork _ _) => if_neg (fun c => ne_rl (c.1.symm.trans c.2.1))

theorem r3 (x : T) : ∀ y : T, rule y (fork x (fork y y)) = fork y (fork x (fork y y))

  | fork _ _ => if_neg (fun c => ne_l c.2.1)

theorem r4 (x y : T) : rule y (fork y (fork x (fork y y))) = x :=

theorem ext' : ∀ {a b : C}, a.1 = b.1 → a = b
  | ⟨_, _⟩, ⟨_, _⟩, rfl => rfl

theorem law (x y : C) : x = f y (f y (f x (f y y))) :=
  ext' (by
    show x.1 = rule y.1 (rule y.1 (rule x.1 (rule y.1 y.1)))

  | (true, _ + 1) => (succ_pred _).symm

theorem add_pred (x : Z) : ∀ y, add x (pred y) = pred (add x y)
  | (false, 0) => rfl
  | (false, _ + 1) => (pred_succ _).symm
  | (true, _) => rfl

theorem succ_add (a : Z) : ∀ b, add (succ a) b = succ (add a b) :=
  zind rfl
    (fun y ih => by rw [add_succ, add_succ, ih])
    (fun y ih => by rw [add_pred, add_pred, ih, pred_succ, succ_pred])

theorem pred_add (a : Z) : ∀ b, add (pred a) b = pred (add a b) :=
  zind rfl
    (fun y ih => by rw [add_succ, add_succ, ih, pred_succ, succ_pred])
    (fun y ih => by rw [add_pred, add_pred, ih])

theorem zero_add : ∀ b : Z, add (false, 0) b = b :=
  zind rfl
    (fun y ih => by rw [add_succ, ih])
    (fun y ih => by rw [add_pred, ih])

theorem assoc (a b : Z) : ∀ c, add (add a b) c = add a (add b c) :=
  zind rfl
    (fun y ih => by rw [add_succ, add_succ, add_succ, ih])
    (fun y ih => by rw [add_pred, add_pred, add_pred, ih])

theorem comm (a : Z) : ∀ b, add a b = add b a :=
  zind (zero_add a).symm
    (fun y ih => by rw [add_succ, succ_add, ih])
    (fun y ih => by rw [add_pred, pred_add, ih])

theorem neg_succ : ∀ a, neg (succ a) = pred (neg a)
  | (false, 0) => rfl
  | (false, _ + 1) => rfl
  | (true, 0) => rfl
  | (true, _ + 1) => rfl

theorem neg_pred : ∀ a, neg (pred a) = succ (neg a)
  | (false, 0) => rfl
  | (false, 0 + 1) => rfl
  | (false, _ + 1 + 1) => rfl
  | (true, _) => rfl

theorem add_neg : ∀ a : Z, add a (neg a) = (false, 0) :=
  zind rfl
    (fun y ih => by rw [neg_succ, add_pred, succ_add, pred_succ, ih])
    (fun y ih => by rw [neg_pred, add_succ, pred_add, succ_pred, ih])

theorem neg_add (b : Z) : ∀ e, neg (add b e) = add (neg b) (neg e) :=
  zind (by show neg b = neg b; rfl)
    (fun y ih => by rw [add_succ, neg_succ, neg_succ, add_pred, ih])
    (fun y ih => by rw [add_pred, neg_pred, neg_pred, add_succ, ih])

theorem neg_neg : ∀ a : Z, neg (neg a) = a
  | (false, 0) => rfl
  | (false, _ + 1) => rfl
  | (true, _) => rfl

theorem sub_rev (a b : Z) : sub a b = neg (sub b a) := by
  unfold sub
  rw [neg_add, neg_neg, comm]

theorem sub_self (a : Z) : sub a a = (false, 0) := add_neg a

theorem sub_add (a b c e : Z) : sub (add b e) (add a c) = add (sub b a) (sub e c) := by
  unfold sub
  rw [neg_add, assoc, assoc, ← assoc e (neg a), comm e (neg a), assoc (neg a) e (neg c)]

import JudgeProblem

namespace submission

inductive T
  | a | b | c
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- How a reduced word continues towards its start: each earlier letter is given relative to the one after it,
so every value of `W` is reduced by construction. -/
inductive R
  | stop
  | next (up : Bool) (r : R)
  deriving DecidableEq

/-- Reduced words of C2 * C2 * C2, last letter first. -/
inductive W
  | e
  | w (l : T) (r : R)
  deriving DecidableEq

def rot : T → Bool → T
  | .a, true => .b
  | .a, false => .c
  | .b, true => .c
  | .b, false => .a
  | .c, true => .a
  | .c, false => .b

def drop (l : T) : R → W
  | .stop => .e
  | .next up r => .w (rot l up) r

/-- Multiply on the right by one letter. -/
def m1 : T → W → W
  | t, .e => .w t .stop
  | .a, .w .a r => drop .a r
  | .a, .w .b r => .w .a (.next true r)
  | .a, .w .c r => .w .a (.next false r)
  | .b, .w .a r => .w .b (.next false r)
  | .b, .w .b r => drop .b r
  | .b, .w .c r => .w .b (.next true r)
  | .c, .w .a r => .w .c (.next true r)
  | .c, .w .b r => .w .c (.next false r)
  | .c, .w .c r => drop .c r

theorem m1_rot : ∀ (l : T) (up : Bool) (r : R), m1 l (.w (rot l up) r) = .w l (.next up r)
  | .a, true, _ => rfl
  | .a, false, _ => rfl
  | .b, true, _ => rfl
  | .b, false, _ => rfl
  | .c, true, _ => rfl
  | .c, false, _ => rfl

theorem m1_self : ∀ (l : T) (r : R), m1 l (.w l r) = drop l r
  | .a, _ => rfl
  | .b, _ => rfl
  | .c, _ => rfl

theorem inv1_drop (l : T) : ∀ r : R, m1 l (drop l r) = .w l r
  | .stop => rfl
  | .next up r => m1_rot l up r

theorem inv1 : ∀ (t : T) (x : W), m1 t (m1 t x) = x
  | .a, .e => rfl
  | .b, .e => rfl
  | .c, .e => rfl
  | .a, .w .a r => inv1_drop .a r
  | .a, .w .b _ => rfl
  | .a, .w .c _ => rfl
  | .b, .w .a _ => rfl
  | .b, .w .b r => inv1_drop .b r
  | .b, .w .c _ => rfl
  | .c, .w .a _ => rfl
  | .c, .w .b _ => rfl
  | .c, .w .c r => inv1_drop .c r

def mulR (x : W) : T → R → W
  | l, .stop => m1 l x
  | l, .next up r => m1 l (mulR x (rot l up) r)

def mul (x : W) : W → W
  | .e => x
  | .w l r => mulR x l r

theorem drop_m (x : W) (t : T) : ∀ r : R, mul x (drop t r) = m1 t (mulR x t r)
  | .stop => (inv1 t x).symm
  | .next _ _ => (inv1 t _).symm

theorem m_m1 (x : W) (t : T) : ∀ y : W, mul x (m1 t y) = m1 t (mul x y)
  | .e => by cases t <;> rfl
  | .w l r => by
    cases t <;> cases l <;> first | exact drop_m x _ r | rfl

theorem assocR (x y : W) : ∀ (r : R) (l : T), mul x (mulR y l r) = mulR (mul x y) l r
  | .stop, l => m_m1 x l y
  | .next up r, l => by
    show mul x (m1 l (mulR y (rot l up) r)) = m1 l (mulR (mul x y) (rot l up) r)
    rw [m_m1, ← assocR x y r (rot l up)]

theorem assoc (x y : W) : ∀ z : W, mul x (mul y z) = mul (mul x y) z
  | .e => rfl
  | .w l r => assocR x y r l

theorem e_mulR : ∀ (r : R) (l : T), mulR .e l r = .w l r
  | .stop, l => by cases l <;> rfl
  | .next up r, l => by
    show m1 l (mulR .e (rot l up) r) = _
    rw [e_mulR r (rot l up), m1_rot]

theorem e_mul : ∀ z : W, mul .e z = z
  | .e => rfl
  | .w l r => e_mulR r l

def invR : T → R → W
  | l, .stop => .w l .stop
  | l, .next up r => mul (.w l .stop) (invR (rot l up) r)

def inv : W → W
  | .e => .e
  | .w l r => invR l r

theorem self_stop : ∀ l : T, mul (.w l .stop) (.w l .stop) = .e
  | .a => rfl
  | .b => rfl
  | .c => rfl

theorem mul_invR : ∀ (r : R) (l : T), mul (.w l r) (invR l r) = .e
  | .stop, l => self_stop l
  | .next up r, l => by
    show mul (.w l (.next up r)) (mul (.w l .stop) (invR (rot l up) r)) = .e
    rw [assoc]
    have h : mul (.w l (.next up r)) (.w l .stop) = .w (rot l up) r := by
      show m1 l (.w l (.next up r)) = _
      rw [m1_self]
      rfl
    rw [h]
    exact mul_invR r (rot l up)

theorem mul_inv : ∀ x : W, mul x (inv x) = .e
  | .e => rfl
  | .w l r => mul_invR r l

theorem invR_mul : ∀ (r : R) (l : T), mul (invR l r) (.w l r) = .e
  | .stop, l => self_stop l
  | .next up r, l => by
    show mul (mul (.w l .stop) (invR (rot l up) r)) (.w l (.next up r)) = .e
    have h : (W.w l (.next up r)) = mul (.w (rot l up) r) (.w l .stop) := (m1_rot l up r).symm
    rw [h, assoc, ← assoc (.w l .stop) (invR (rot l up) r), invR_mul r (rot l up)]
    exact self_stop l

theorem inv_mul : ∀ x : W, mul (inv x) x = .e
  | .e => rfl
  | .w l r => invR_mul r l

theorem uniq {a b c : W} (h : mul a c = b) : mul (inv a) b = c := by
  rw [← h, assoc, inv_mul, e_mul]

theorem mul_ldiv (a b : W) : mul a (mul (inv a) b) = b := by
  rw [assoc, mul_inv, e_mul]

def first : T → R → T
  | l, .stop => l
  | l, .next up r => first (rot l up) r

/-- The function of the ETP's `ThreeC2`: `f 1 = 1`, a letter goes to the next letter, a longer word to its first letter. -/
def f : W → W
  | .e => .e
  | .w l .stop => .w (rot l true) .stop
  | .w l (.next up r) => .w (first (rot l up) r) .stop

/-- `x ◇ y = x f(x⁻¹ y)`. -/
def op (x y : W) : W := mul x (f (mul (inv x) y))

theorem op_T (x u v : W) : op (mul x u) (mul x v) = mul x (op u v) := by
  unfold op
  have h : mul (mul x u) (mul (inv u) v) = mul x v := by
    rw [← assoc, mul_ldiv]
  rw [uniq h, assoc]

theorem op_e (z : W) : op .e z = f z := by
  show mul .e (f (mul .e z)) = _
  rw [e_mul, e_mul]

theorem left_ext (B : T) : ∀ (r : R) (l : T), first l r ≠ B →
    ∃ u r2, mul (.w B .stop) (.w l r) = .w l (.next u r2) ∧ first (rot l u) r2 = B
  | .stop, l, hne => by
    cases l <;> cases B <;> first
      | exact absurd rfl hne
      | exact ⟨true, .stop, rfl, rfl⟩
      | exact ⟨false, .stop, rfl, rfl⟩
  | .next up r, l, hne => by
    have ⟨u, r2, h1, h2⟩ := left_ext B r (rot l up) hne
    refine ⟨up, .next u r2, ?_, h2⟩
    show m1 l (mulR (.w B .stop) (rot l up) r) = _
    have h3 : mulR (.w B .stop) (rot l up) r = .w (rot l up) (.next u r2) := h1
    rw [h3, m1_rot]

theorem rot_ne : ∀ A : T, A ≠ rot A true
  | .a => nofun
  | .b => nofun
  | .c => nofun

theorem m1_stop : ∀ B : T, mul (.w B .stop) (.w B .stop) = .e := self_stop

theorem core : ∀ z : W, W.e = op (op .e (op .e z)) z
  | .e => rfl
  | .w .a .stop => rfl
  | .w .b .stop => rfl
  | .w .c .stop => rfl
  | .w l (.next up r) => by
    rw [op_e, op_e]
    have ⟨u, r2, h1, h2⟩ := left_ext (rot (first l (.next up r)) true) (.next up r) l (rot_ne _)
    show W.e = mul (.w (rot (first (rot l up) r) true) .stop)
      (f (mul (.w (rot (first (rot l up) r) true) .stop) (.w l (.next up r))))
    have h1' : mul (.w (rot (first (rot l up) r) true) .stop) (.w l (.next up r)) = .w l (.next u r2) := h1
    rw [h1']
    show W.e = mul (.w (rot (first (rot l up) r) true) .stop) (.w (first (rot l u) r2) .stop)
    have h2' : first (rot l u) r2 = rot (first (rot l up) r) true := h2
    rw [h2']
    exact (self_stop _).symm

theorem law (x y : W) : x = op (op x (op x y)) y := by
  have ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, y = mul x z := ⟨_, (mul_ldiv x y).symm⟩
  subst hz
  have t1 : op x (mul x z) = mul x (op .e z) := op_T x .e z
  have t2 : op x (mul x (op .e z)) = mul x (op .e (op .e z)) := op_T x .e _
  have t3 : op (mul x (op .e (op .e z))) (mul x z) = mul x (op (op .e (op .e z)) z) := op_T x _ _
  rw [t1, t2, t3, ← core z]
  rfl


instance mag : Magma W := ⟨fun a b => op b a⟩

theorem lhs : EquationLHS W := fun x y => law x y

theorem rhs : ¬ EquationRHS W :=
  fun h => absurd (h W.e (W.w .a .stop)) (by decide)

end submission

  | .stop => rfl
  | .next up r => m1_rot l up r

theorem inv1 : ∀ (t : T) (x : W), m1 t (m1 t x) = x
  | .a, .e => rfl
  | .b, .e => rfl
  | .c, .e => rfl
  | .a, .w .a r => inv1_drop .a r
  | .a, .w .b _ => rfl
  | .a, .w .c _ => rfl
  | .b, .w .a _ => rfl
  | .b, .w .b r => inv1_drop .b r
  | .b, .w .c _ => rfl
  | .c, .w .a _ => rfl
  | .c, .w .b _ => rfl
  | .c, .w .c r => inv1_drop .c r

def mulR (x : W) : T → R → W
  | l, .stop => m1 l x
  | l, .next up r => m1 l (mulR x (rot l up) r)

def mul (x : W) : W → W
  | .e => x
  | .w l r => mulR x l r

theorem drop_m (x : W) (t : T) : ∀ r : R, mul x (drop t r) = m1 t (mulR x t r)
  | .stop => (inv1 t x).symm
  | .next _ _ => (inv1 t _).symm

theorem m_m1 (x : W) (t : T) : ∀ y : W, mul x (m1 t y) = m1 t (mul x y)
  | .e => by cases t <;> rfl
  | .w l r => by
    cases t <;> cases l <;> first | exact drop_m x _ r | rfl

theorem assocR (x y : W) : ∀ (r : R) (l : T), mul x (mulR y l r) = mulR (mul x y) l r
  | .stop, l => m_m1 x l y
  | .next up r, l => by
    show mul x (m1 l (mulR y (rot l up) r)) = m1 l (mulR (mul x y) (rot l up) r)
    rw [m_m1, ← assocR x y r (rot l up)]

theorem assoc (x y : W) : ∀ z : W, mul x (mul y z) = mul (mul x y) z
  | .e => rfl
  | .w l r => assocR x y r l

theorem e_mulR : ∀ (r : R) (l : T), mulR .e l r = .w l r
  | .stop, l => by cases l <;> rfl
  | .next up r, l => by
    show m1 l (mulR .e (rot l up) r) = _
    rw [e_mulR r (rot l up), m1_rot]

theorem e_mul : ∀ z : W, mul .e z = z
  | .e => rfl
  | .w l r => e_mulR r l

def invR : T → R → W
  | l, .stop => .w l .stop
  | l, .next up r => mul (.w l .stop) (invR (rot l up) r)

def inv : W → W
  | .e => .e
  | .w l r => invR l r

theorem self_stop : ∀ l : T, mul (.w l .stop) (.w l .stop) = .e
  | .a => rfl
  | .b => rfl
  | .c => rfl

theorem mul_invR : ∀ (r : R) (l : T), mul (.w l r) (invR l r) = .e
  | .stop, l => self_stop l
  | .next up r, l => by
    show mul (.w l (.next up r)) (mul (.w l .stop) (invR (rot l up) r)) = .e
    rw [assoc]
    have h : mul (.w l (.next up r)) (.w l .stop) = .w (rot l up) r := by
      show m1 l (.w l (.next up r)) = _
      rw [m1_self]
      rfl
    rw [h]
    exact mul_invR r (rot l up)

theorem mul_inv : ∀ x : W, mul x (inv x) = .e
  | .e => rfl
  | .w l r => mul_invR r l

theorem invR_mul : ∀ (r : R) (l : T), mul (invR l r) (.w l r) = .e
  | .stop, l => self_stop l
  | .next up r, l => by
    show mul (mul (.w l .stop) (invR (rot l up) r)) (.w l (.next up r)) = .e
    have h : (W.w l (.next up r)) = mul (.w (rot l up) r) (.w l .stop) := (m1_rot l up r).symm
    rw [h, assoc, ← assoc (.w l .stop) (invR (rot l up) r), invR_mul r (rot l up)]
    exact self_stop l

theorem inv_mul : ∀ x : W, mul (inv x) x = .e
  | .e => rfl
  | .w l r => invR_mul r l

theorem uniq {a b c : W} (h : mul a c = b) : mul (inv a) b = c := by
  rw [← h, assoc, inv_mul, e_mul]

theorem mul_ldiv (a b : W) : mul a (mul (inv a) b) = b := by
  rw [assoc, mul_inv, e_mul]

def first : T → R → T
  | l, .stop => l
  | l, .next up r => first (rot l up) r

/-- The function of the ETP's `ThreeC2`: `f 1 = 1`, a letter goes to the next letter, a longer word to its first letter. -/
def f : W → W
  | .e => .e
  | .w l .stop => .w (rot l true) .stop
  | .w l (.next up r) => .w (first (rot l up) r) .stop

/-- `x ◇ y = x f(x⁻¹ y)`. -/
def op (x y : W) : W := mul x (f (mul (inv x) y))

theorem op_T (x u v : W) : op (mul x u) (mul x v) = mul x (op u v) := by
  unfold op
  have h : mul (mul x u) (mul (inv u) v) = mul x v := by
    rw [← assoc, mul_ldiv]
  rw [uniq h, assoc]

theorem op_e (z : W) : op .e z = f z := by
  show mul .e (f (mul .e z)) = _
  rw [e_mul, e_mul]

theorem left_ext (B : T) : ∀ (r : R) (l : T), first l r ≠ B →
    ∃ u r2, mul (.w B .stop) (.w l r) = .w l (.next u r2) ∧ first (rot l u) r2 = B
  | .stop, l, hne => by
    cases l <;> cases B <;> first
      | exact absurd rfl hne
      | exact ⟨true, .stop, rfl, rfl⟩
      | exact ⟨false, .stop, rfl, rfl⟩
  | .next up r, l, hne => by
    have ⟨u, r2, h1, h2⟩ := left_ext B r (rot l up) hne
    refine ⟨up, .next u r2, ?_, h2⟩
    show m1 l (mulR (.w B .stop) (rot l up) r) = _
    have h3 : mulR (.w B .stop) (rot l up) r = .w (rot l up) (.next u r2) := h1
    rw [h3, m1_rot]

theorem rot_ne : ∀ A : T, A ≠ rot A true
  | .a => nofun
  | .b => nofun
  | .c => nofun

theorem m1_stop : ∀ B : T, mul (.w B .stop) (.w B .stop) = .e := self_stop

theorem core : ∀ z : W, W.e = op (op .e (op .e z)) z
  | .e => rfl
  | .w .a .stop => rfl
  | .w .b .stop => rfl
  | .w .c .stop => rfl
  | .w l (.next up r) => by
    rw [op_e, op_e]
    have ⟨u, r2, h1, h2⟩ := left_ext (rot (first l (.next up r)) true) (.next up r) l (rot_ne _)
    show W.e = mul (.w (rot (first (rot l up) r) true) .stop)
      (f (mul (.w (rot (first (rot l up) r) true) .stop) (.w l (.next up r))))
    have h1' : mul (.w (rot (first (rot l up) r) true) .stop) (.w l (.next up r)) = .w l (.next u r2) := h1
    rw [h1']
    show W.e = mul (.w (rot (first (rot l up) r) true) .stop) (.w (first (rot l u) r2) .stop)
    have h2' : first (rot l u) r2 = rot (first (rot l up) r) true := h2
    rw [h2']
    exact (self_stop _).symm

theorem law (x y : W) : x = op (op x (op x y)) y := by
  have ⟨z, hz⟩ : ∃ z, y = mul x z := ⟨_, (mul_ldiv x y).symm⟩
  subst hz
  have t1 : op x (mul x z) = mul x (op .e z) := op_T x .e z
  have t2 : op x (mul x (op .e z)) = mul x (op .e (op .e z)) := op_T x .e _
  have t3 : op (mul x (op .e (op .e z))) (mul x z) = mul x (op (op .e (op .e z)) z) := op_T x _ _
  rw [t1, t2, t3, ← core z]
  rfl


instance mag : Magma W := ⟨op⟩

theorem lhs : EquationLHS W := fun x y => law x y

theorem rhs : ¬ EquationRHS W :=
  fun h => absurd (h W.e (W.w .a .stop)) (by decide)

end submission

def submission : Goal := ⟨submission.W, submission.mag, submission.lhs, submission.rhs⟩
